$comment: Every floor here cites the feature that imposes it. A number without a reason is a guess, and a guess cannot be revised later on purpose.

harness.minReason: the turn identifier the ledger is keyed on became a common input field at this version; taken from the harness's own release history and not from a measurement here, because no older build was available to run against
harness.testedEvidence: measured: every probe in bench/probes/run.mjs ran against this build

node.minReason: the built-in test runner is stable from this version and sets a non-zero exit code on failure, so the suite needs no dependency
node.minEvidence: reasoned: the floor the runtime feature imposes; the matrix will exercise it against this version once it has run, and until then no run has measured it

git.minReason: resolving the temporary index path with rev-parse --git-path, which the snapshot uses so the index sits inside the git directory rather than in the working tree; that option arrived in this version, and the plumbing around it is older
git.minEvidence: reasoned: derived from the commands the snapshot exercises, not from a run against that version
git.futureFloorReason: signature with an SSH key, which is what will let a signed history be verified with no network and no account; nothing in this milestone signs or verifies anything, so the floor is recorded rather than declared

stop.softVerifiedReason: probe F1b: context supplied through hookSpecificOutput on a non-blocking stop both continues the turn and reaches the model, observed on 2.1.261
